title: Passive and Impersonal Se in Formal Writing
goal: Apply the written norm to passive se and impersonal se: agree the verb with a thing, keep it singular before a + person.

items: I can make the verb agree with the thing after passive *se* (*se publicaron los datos*).
I can keep the verb singular when *se* is followed by *a* and a person (*se entrevistó a los autores*).
I can spot and correct agreement errors with *se* in a formal text.
